recap: On their Sunday walk, Utterson and Enfield stop at the by-street door. Enfield says the Hyde affair is over, but Utterson admits he once saw Hyde and felt the same repulsion. Enfield reveals the door is Dr. Jekyll's back way. Looking up, Utterson sees Jekyll sadly at the middle window. Jekyll says he is very low and it will not last long. He declines their walk, saying he dare not. When Utterson suggests talking from below, Jekyll's smile becomes abject terror and the window is thrust down. The two men leave the court in silence, pale with horror, Utterson saying “God forgive us” twice.
